schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE INSURANCE (
    PID INT,
    TIV_2015 NUMERIC,
    TIV_2016 NUMERIC,
    LAT NUMERIC,
    LON NUMERIC,
    PRIMARY KEY (PID),
    CHECK (TIV_2015 >= 0),
    CHECK (TIV_2016 >= 0)
);
q1: SELECT ROUND(SUM(TIV_2016),2) TIV_2016 FROM INSURANCE WHERE TIV_2015 IN (SELECT TIV_2015 FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY TIV_2015 HAVING COUNT(*)>1) AND (LAT,LON) IN (SELECT LAT,LON FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY LAT,LON HAVING COUNT(*)=1)
q2: SELECT SUM(TIV_2016) AS TIV_2016 FROM INSURANCE WHERE (LAT, LON) IN (SELECT LAT, LON FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY LAT, LON HAVING COUNT(*) = 1) AND TIV_2015 IN (SELECT TIV_2015 FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY TIV_2015 HAVING COUNT(TIV_2015) > 1)
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(TIV_2016),2) TIV_2016 FROM INSURANCE WHERE TIV_2015 IN (SELECT TIV_2015 FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY TIV_2015 HAVING COUNT(*)>1) AND (LAT,LON) IN (SELECT LAT,LON FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY LAT,LON HAVING COUNT(*)=1)
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT SUM(TIV_2016) AS TIV_2016 FROM INSURANCE WHERE (LAT, LON) IN (SELECT LAT, LON FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY LAT, LON HAVING COUNT(*) = 1) AND TIV_2015 IN (SELECT TIV_2015 FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY TIV_2015 HAVING COUNT(TIV_2015) > 1)
counterexample: INSERT INTO INSURANCE (PID, TIV_2015, TIV_2016, LAT, LON) VALUES (1, 1000, 50.2837, 37.7749, -122.4194); INSERT INTO INSURANCE (PID, TIV_2015, TIV_2016, LAT, LON) VALUES (2, 1000, 50.2841, 37.7749, -122.4194);
explanation: Q1 rounds the sum of TIV_2016 to 2 decimal places, while Q2 returns the sum of TIV_2016 without rounding.
counterexample_dsp: A test database with two policies where the sum of TIV_2016 is 100.56789. Q1 should return 100.57, while Q2 should return 100.56789.
